calibration.5: Exactly matches spec text. All described behaviors, constraints, and rules are present and working.
calibration.4: Working as described but with minor UI/UX gaps or edge cases.
calibration.3: Core functionality works but has notable gaps (missing sub-feature, rough UI).
calibration.2: Partially implemented. Significant divergence from spec.
calibration.1: Missing or broken. Spec-described behavior does not exist or fails.

dimensions.fidelity: Do business rules and constraints hold?
dimensions.ux: Does the experience match the pitch (Hurdles Not Blockers, Dark Pool, Closed-Loop Economy, Privacy-First, Consent-First Reveal)?
